name: room-scoped-lights-simple
description: ROOM-SCOPED-LIGHTS (R7-AE) simple rung. The flag is on by default; the fixture point lights are a constant pool of 8 that stays mounted (dark) with the lights off, so in walk mode the lights switch compiles ZERO programs (z16). Orbit keeps every fixture (8 + 11). In the living room the pool carries the living room's 4 lamps plus the kitchen, corridor and service yard seen through open boundaries; the bedrooms behind closed doors are not lit through their walls. Control arm: fixture-lights-all-on.json (?ff=roomScopedLights:off).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour(21); s.setLightsMode('off') })()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-by-default
steps.eval: (() => { const on = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomScopedLights; if (on !== true) throw new Error('roomScopedLights should default ON, got ' + on); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: define-census
steps.eval: (() => { window.__census = () => { let n = 0, lit = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isPointLight) { n++; if (o.intensity > 0) lit++ } }); return { n, lit, programs: window.__three.gl.info.programs.length } }; return 'ok' })()

steps.name: assert-orbit-off-pool-mounted-dark
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__census(); console.log('RSL orbit-off ' + JSON.stringify(c)); if (c.n !== 8 || c.lit !== 0) throw new Error('lights off: expected 8 dark pool slots, got ' + JSON.stringify(c)); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: assert-orbit-every-fixture
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__census(); console.log('RSL orbit-on ' + JSON.stringify(c)); if (c.n !== 19 || c.lit !== 19) throw new Error('orbit must light every fixture (8 slots + 11): ' + JSON.stringify(c)); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11, 7); l.setYaw(0.07); l.setPitch(0); window.__three.invalidate(); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: assert-walk-pool
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__census(); console.log('RSL walk-living ' + JSON.stringify(c)); if (c.n !== 8) throw new Error('walk mode: expected the constant pool of 8, got ' + c.n); if (c.lit !== 7) throw new Error('living room: expected 7 lit (4 living + kitchen + corridor + service yard), got ' + c.lit); let b3 = false; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isPointLight && o.intensity > 0 && Math.abs(o.position.x - 7.66) < 0.2 && Math.abs(o.position.z - 2.46) < 0.2) b3 = true }); if (b3) throw new Error('bedroom 3 is behind a closed door and must not light the living room through the wall'); window.__progOn = c.programs; return 'ok' })()

steps.name: assert-walk-off-no-recompile
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__census(); console.log('RSL walk-off ' + JSON.stringify(c)); if (c.n !== 8 || c.lit !== 0) throw new Error('walk lights off: expected 8 dark slots, got ' + JSON.stringify(c)); if (c.programs !== window.__progOn) throw new Error('lights switch recompiled: programs ' + window.__progOn + ' -> ' + c.programs); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: assert-walk-on-again-no-recompile
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__census(); if (c.lit !== 7 || c.programs !== window.__progOn) throw new Error('lights back on: ' + JSON.stringify(c) + ' programs before ' + window.__progOn); return 'ok' })()
